area.title: Area
area.description: Which permit data source to pull from. Add more areas in src/sources.js (and an adapter in src/adapters/ if it is a new kind of portal).

trade.title: Trade
trade.description: Which trade to score leads for.

includeIssued.title: Include issued permits
includeIssued.description: If off, only pulls 'applied' permits (bids not yet locked — usually the better lead).

minScore.title: Minimum score
minScore.description: Drop any lead scoring below this (0-100+). Matches the Tier C floor by default.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How far back to search. Applies to date-range sources (Accela, ArcGIS); the Portland CSV export ignores it.

maxRecords.title: Max records
maxRecords.description: Safety cap on how many permits to pull before scoring. Accela visits one detail page per record, so a high cap means a long, heavy run.
